description: A failed login attempt is on the mandatory emission list; the resulting audit.event carries result failure with every other field still populated. on_behalf_of is ABSENT, not null: EVT-080 types it "ULID, optional ... absent for a self-attributed action", and a login failure is self-attributed. The case pinned an explicit null until 2026-07-31, which no producer can emit — the platform's own constructor marshals the field omitempty — so the expectation described a payload the platform is incapable of producing. The validator does accept an explicit null; that leniency is exercised by internal/events/audit_event_test.go, not by this case.
